verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm offering legal counsel, plus static entrepreneur resources: a glossary, FAQs and document generators. Autonomous background automations are a software-platform axis that does not fit this kind of professional-services provider. The 'Automated Convertible Note' is a one-off document generator, not a recurring or background automation, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
